task_title: AI pathing mode A/B architecture with risk/reward seam-seeking

self_review.notes: Lightweight mode toggle: AIPathingMode enum + branching in BehaviorTreeAI.poll(). Risk/reward fused heading scorer samples 7 candidate angles, computes squared-distance danger from perceived enemies, scores by progress*1.15 + reward*0.95 - danger*1.45. A/B validated: 10 seeds, both modes 90% win rate, identical outcomes. No regressions. Determinism preserved (all RNG via world.rng). Backward compatible (legacy is default). Future work: refactor to PathingProvider interface after validating approach with headless data.
